name: happy-path
title: create → link child → add step (started: reason) → independent verify → request close
description: The owner (A) creates a mission with a code-kind declared end — born `active` (Mission v3 §3.4: no draft, no approval door). A links a child session C to the fixed end, which STARTS the mission, then adds a custom step: once started, `reason` is required and stored (§3.4's started-based reason rule). A different session B verifies the fixed end; A requests the close. B differs from the linked C, so the fixed end must land on `verified`, never `self-verified`.

phases.prompt: 1. mcp__harnu__mission_create with folder="{{folder}}", title="Happy path", sessionId="{{self}}", declaredEnd={"kind":"code","target":"src/feature.ts exports feature()","evidence":"the unit test for feature() passes"}.

1. mcp__harnu__mission_link_child with folder="{{folder}}", missionId="{{m.happy-path.id}}", stepId="{{m.happy-path.end}}", link={"kind":"session","ref":"{{session.C}}"}.
2. mcp__harnu__mission_add_step with folder="{{folder}}", missionId="{{m.happy-path.id}}", title="Write the unit test", verification="verifier", reason="the declared end cites a unit test that does not exist yet".

1. mcp__harnu__mission_verify_step with folder="{{folder}}", missionId="{{m.happy-path.id}}", stepId="{{m.happy-path.end}}", verdict="met", evidence="EVAL-HAPPY-EVIDENCE: ran the test, it passes", sessionId="{{self}}".
